maddeler.e:
أتدارأ (form VI)
# أَتَدَارَأُ (ʔatadāraʔu) /ʔa.ta.daː.ra.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# أَتَدَارَأَ (ʔatadāraʔa) /ʔa.ta.daː.ra.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# أَتَدَارَأْ (ʔatadāraʔ) /ʔa.ta.daː.raʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
